extraFacts.fact: NPTF (Dryseal) is a taper pipe thread cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread (ASME B1.20.3).
NPSM is a straight (parallel) pipe thread for mechanical joints (ASME B1.20.1): it does not seal on the thread, so an NPSM swivel end seals on its seat, which on these Dixon swivels is a 30° seat.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.1; Dixon swivel listing feature note (female NPSM swivel seals on a 30° seat)

extraFacts.fact: A JIC 37° flare end (SAE J514, ISO 8434-2) seals metal-to-metal on a 74° included cone and is not interchangeable with a 45° SAE flare.
NPT pipe-thread ends carry a lower pressure limit than the same size in a flare, boss or flange end; for example a 2" NPT end is limited to 1,000 psi.
extraFacts.source: SAE J514 pipe-thread end pressure limits (Indus Hydraulics NPTF pressure-limits note)
